spellbook.finance/limitations: A row is a catalogue price change between two snapshots, never a sale, a quote, or what a marketplace will pay today. Confirm any number on the marketplace before acting on it.

Daily and weekly card lists are ordered by stored reported pctChange, capped at ±500 by the current producer, with up to 100 gainers and 100 losers per game over covered source candidates. A value at 500 can represent a larger computation; tied capped rows do not establish an uncapped winner. This is not a complete market census or an opportunity ranking. The 30d/90d sealed windows have separate coverage.

Absence can reflect source/tracking coverage, omitted history, movement thresholds, the per-game top-list cap or caller game access. Public Magic weekly reports compare retained bulk snapshots by position; other supported history-backed paths use a date cutoff. Row input-leg dates are not returned, so weekly is not proof of an exact seven-day input pair. Do not transfer one source path’s selection rules to another. Absence never proves the price held.
sealedGainers and sealedLosers are populated only on the 30d and 90d windows. Without Investor access the backend returns the top three of each and gatedCount says how many rows it withheld.
A Pokémon row is qualified by productId, language, finish and variant. Do not collapse Reverse Holo, 1st Edition or other variants into regular or foil.
availability.status unavailable and missingFields name absent evidence. Never turn an unavailable result into a zero change or an empty-market claim.

A row's swing30d reads the price history of that row's finish. It is null under $1 and below 10 measured moves, and it is absent on the 30d and 90d windows and on boards published before the field existed. A missing swing30d says nothing about how far the price moves.
A game can be omitted when its feature is disabled for the caller.

generatedAt stamps publication of a cached daily/weekly board; date and computedAt identify a stored run when present. provenance.fetchedAt is retrieval time. Independent provider observation and row input-leg clocks are unknown. Check stale-generation limitations. If calculating a change from price/previousPrice, label separate arithmetic over rounded returned USD inputs; do not replace the reported pctChange silently.

description: Read published daily/weekly card price movers or supported 30d/90d sealed reports. Returns gainers/losers, reported game/printing/finish when supplied, current and previous USD prices, stored pctChange, swing30d, cardUrl and run/publication dates. Daily/weekly reported percentages and direction lists have producer caps over covered source candidates; read the limits. Capped ties do not identify the largest uncapped market move. For what increased this week, use window=weekly, then read the pricing guide through spellbook_guides and its returned resource URI for window, cap and clock interpretation. A printing price read qualifies one reported candidate; missing source dates remain unknown.

context.description: Optional analytics context: briefly describe the user's underlying goal in one sentence. Do not copy prompts, personal details, credentials, identifiers, or tool arguments. Omit for private tasks.

game.description: Restrict card movers to one game. Omit for the default Magic board.

window.description: Which price-change window to read: daily, weekly, 30d or 90d. Omit for the default window.
